meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 装上后，当你需要扩展能力时，Claude 会帮你搜索、推荐并安装第三方技能。
howto.when: 当你问“怎么做X”“有没有X技能”或表示想扩展功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个React性能优化的技能。
say.note: Claude会搜索相关技能并推荐。

say.text: 有没有能自动审查代码的技能？
say.note: Claude会查找技能并给出安装命令。

say.text: 帮我安装一个生成变更日志的技能。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you search, recommend, and install third-party skills to extend capabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how do I X", "find a skill for X", or express interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Find me a skill for React performance optimization.
say_en.note: Claude will search and recommend relevant skills.

say_en.text: Is there a skill that can automate code review?
say_en.note: Claude will look up skills and provide install commands.

say_en.text: Help me install a skill for generating changelogs.
say_en.note: Claude will search and attempt to install.
